experiences.name: Hanoi Old Quarter Street Food Tour
experiences.description: Wander through the maze-like streets of Hanoi's Old Quarter sampling iconic Vietnamese dishes including Bun Cha, Banh Mi, Pho, and Egg Coffee from local vendors and hole-in-the-wall eateries. Join a budget walking food tour or explore independently using a street food map.

experiences.name: Hoi An Ancient Town Lantern Festival & Night Market
experiences.description: Explore the UNESCO-listed Ancient Town of Hoi An, browse the vibrant night market, release a lantern on the Thu Bon River, and feast on local specialties like Cao Lau and White Rose Dumplings from street stalls. The town glows with hundreds of silk lanterns every evening.

experiences.name: Motorbiking the Hai Van Pass
experiences.description: Rent a motorbike or join a budget group tour to ride the legendary Hai Van Pass between Da Nang and Hue, one of Southeast Asia's most scenic coastal mountain roads. Stop at the old French and American war bunkers at the summit for panoramic views of the coastline.
experiences.location: Hai Van Pass, between Da Nang and Hue

experiences.name: Mekong Delta Sampan Boat & Local Market Experience
experiences.description: Take a budget day trip from Ho Chi Minh City into the Mekong Delta, hopping on a traditional sampan boat through narrow canals, visiting the Cai Rang floating market, tasting fresh tropical fruits, and observing rural Vietnamese life up close.
experiences.location: Cai Rang, Can Tho, Mekong Delta

experiences.name: Mui Ne Beach & Sand Dunes Sunrise Trek
experiences.description: Head to the red and white sand dunes of Mui Ne for an early morning trek at sunrise, then cool off at the nearby beach. Rent a cheap jeep or ATV with fellow backpackers to explore the dunes, and finish with a bowl of fresh seafood Bun Ca at a beachside shack.
